name: Guardbreaker rank 2 applies an additional stack of Pommel Smash's debuff (#2231)
contract: Guardbreaker rank 2 681493 text: 'Pommel Smash now strikes 2 additional nearby enemies and applies an additional stack.' In the client Spell.dbc (2026-09-17) its effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL casting 582588, the debuff Pommel Smash 680515 applies once through its own trigger-spell effect (StackAmount 5), but 681493 has ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, and SpellMgr does not generate proc entries for a spell without DBC ProcFlags, so the effect never ran. A spell_proc row on Pommel Smash's class mask (word2 0x2000000, melee spell class, on hit) makes each Pommel Smash hit add the second stack: a fresh target ends with exactly 2 stacks, 1 on main. Rank 1's chain-target clause is native and not asserted.

steps.label: Let the weapon swap cooldown expire
Pommel Smash's own effect applies its debuff
Guardbreaker rank 2 adds one more stack: 1 from Pommel Smash plus 1 from the proc
